description: Filter the enterprise GenAI use case catalog by industry, business function, and current maturity level. Returns ranked matches with ROI band, effort estimate, prerequisites, and metrics.

function.description: Business function filter. One of: any, sales, marketing, engineering, product, operations, support, hr, legal, finance, analytics.

industry.description: Industry filter. One of: any, financial-services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, technology, public-sector, professional-services, media.

maturityLevel.description: Your current framework maturity level, 1-6. Only use cases feasible at or below this level are returned. Default 3.

name: find_use_cases
